flags.EQUIVALENT: K14 and K14w only (06L-C C15; 06P P4 / P6: TOST ±1 % on the unadjusted 90% CI)

general_rules: A exceeds B only when the paired 95% CI of the contrast lies above its reference (0 for a paired Δ, 100 for a retention R); an interval that includes the reference reads 'no detectable difference' (the claim vocabulary of EVALUATION_CONTRACT_V4 §7), never 'no difference' or 'equivalent': an absence of evidence is not evidence of absence, and only a registered equivalence test (K14's margin, 06L-C C15) can support 'equivalent'.

Only the loaded registry's contrasts (report section 1, CONFIRMATORY rows under their registered rule and seeds) carry confirmatory wording; every other number is DESCRIPTIVE and is never phrased as a finding.

Every retention sentence names the recipe and the reference: 'matched-exposure retention of the registered FL recipe' (06L-C C6), relative to a cloud model trained on 5-100-event users; never 'FL retains X %' without the recipe (06I §6(c)); never 'a lower bound' (06L-C C6).
VALIDATION values are max-of-marks; the single TEST look is the only unbiased number (06A §9(g)).
A contrast flagged SEED_SENSITIVE carries the flag in the same sentence; every CI covers user sampling only, conditional on the trained models.
An arm flagged BELOW_DEVICE_HEURISTIC (CI of Δ(arm − LAST) below 0) carries the flag in the same sentence as its retention (06L-C C3).

Non-DP federated arms are never called private: the uploaded deltas reveal the viewed items and secure aggregation is not simulated (06I §7(a); 06L-C C1); a DP arm states the 06L-C C2 guarantee in full.
K17-K19 and K20b are compositions with K15 (see algebraic_dependencies); they are never presented as independent evidence or as a second headline (06L-C C4).
The backbone was selected under rule T1; never 'SASRec beats GRU' (06B §7(c)); GRU_D128 vs C_SMALL is DESCRIPTIVE and never a family choice (06L-C C11).
Anything added after the first VALIDATION read is POST_VALIDATION_EXPLORATORY and never confirmatory (06L-C C5).

An 'events to parity' (or events-to-X) sentence is written only from a persistent hit of the 06L-C C10 rule (the parity holds at the next registered h too, with the CI lower bound >= X), naming the rule and the reference (C_BIG FULL history or matched-h C_BIG(h)); a first-hit h alone, NO_CI, NO_NEXT_H or NO_C_REF supports no such sentence; the curves are DESCRIPTIVE.
headline_template:
# Headline / abstract template (number-free; 06L-C C12; 06P hierarchy)

Placeholders `{Kx}`, `{Kx_CI}`, `{Kx_CLAIM}` are filled from the frozen RETENTION_RESULT.json of the single TEST look (`{Kx_CLAIM}` = the claim-register template key stamped on that K); the wording follows CLAIM_REGISTER.json.

1. Task. Next different viewed item within the session (views only), given the user's prior events across sessions (USER_HISTORY_L50); every retention is relative to a cloud model trained on 5-100-event users.
2. Cloud. The C_BIG cloud model reaches {K15} % [{K15_CI}] of the full-data cloud model C_FULL (K15, one seed).
3. Federated from a random start (secondary: the random-start ablation, K2). The matched-exposure retention of the registered FL recipe <{FL_RECIPE}> is {K2} % [{K2_CI}] of C_BIG ({K2_CLAIM}); the pretrained start adds {K_INIT} [{K_INIT_CI}] (K_INIT); against the no-training device heuristic LAST, FA − LAST = {K11b} [{K11b_CI}] ({K11b_CLAIM}); headroom R* = {FA_R_STAR} %.
4. Federated + DP. At ε = 8 (central DP, trusted aggregator, client-level, δ = 5e-6, conditional on the public bootstrap block; tuning not accounted) the model keeps {K12} % [{K12_CI}] of its non-private twin (K12, CONTROLLED_BUDGET).
5. Cloud model shipped + fine-tuned on device. FT_C on MAIN is an L1 base + local fine-tune: K7 = {K7} % [{K7_CI}]; the L5 answers are K9c = FT_PRE − PRE = {K9c} [{K9c_CI}] and, for base-unseen users, K9b = {K9b} [{K9b_CI}].
6. Device-only. The device-only envelope (LO, LAST, RULE) retains {ENVELOPE_R} % of C_BIG; LO alone (an untuned from-θ0 control) {K8} % [{K8_CI}].
7. Deployment branch (PRIMARY, the pair K20b + K21; the Edge answer). Federation from the pretrained model with the item tables frozen (FA_WARM* = S8) retains {K20b} % [{K20b_CI}] of its matched cloud reference C_FULL (K20b, {K20b_CLAIM}), the pretrained model alone {K20c} % [{K20c_CI}] (K20c); federated training on the private users adds {K21} [{K21_CI}] over θ_pre (K21, {K21_CLAIM}); freezing the item tables costs {S8_S7} [{S8_S7_CI}] at {S8_BYTES_RATIO} of the bytes (S8 − S7, DESCRIPTIVE).
8. Privacy. The adversary is an honest-but-curious browser vendor; non-DP federated updates reveal the viewed items and secure aggregation is not simulated; only the DP arms carry a formal guarantee (06L-C C1, C2).
